searchText: The EL teams are mostly done with updating the default gas limit to 45M, could we have similar releases from the CL teams? next Nimbus release will do so, waiting on one important bug fix + usual testing cycle Prysm pr is already out, I think we should have them in next release as well we have a PR too for the next release We just published the v1.6.0-alpha.3 release. Please note that there are new fork choice tests for Fulu which are expected to fail without the appropriate client codebase changes; there's a new `columns` parameter which replaces the `blob` & `proof` parameters. If you run into any issues, please ping me.
